category: hosted push notification service for iOS, Android and the web (a Brevo company)

free_tier.stated: 0 subscribers is free; a 14-day free trial gives all features with no credit card. From 1 subscriber the push plan is EUR 1 per month for 1-1000 subscribers, EUR 2 for 1001-2000 and EUR 3 for 2001-3000, plus EUR 1 for every further 1000.
free_tier.notes: The unit stated by the vendor is a subscriber: a unique device and application or website combination. There is no ongoing free tier at any positive subscriber count, only the 14-day trial.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: no per-payload or per-message size cap is published on the pricing or billing pages read

retention.stated: By default navigation data is kept for 3 months; the user decides what data is stored and for how long. If payment fails after the trial, sending is blocked but project and subscriber data is kept for 90 days, after which it is deleted from the servers.
retention.notes: The 90-day figure is the unpaid-account deletion window; the navigation figure of 3 months is a separate default and is stated on the pricing page.

egress.terms: not metered per message or per byte: push sending is unlimited on the plan and the bill is based on subscriber count

interface_detail: A documented RESTful API sends notifications from a backend or CMS, and the Management API automates sends; iOS, Android and web SDKs register devices, and an online dashboard designs notifications and reads real-time analytics. Web and iOS web push register through the browser service worker.
endpoint: unverified: the API base URL is not stated on the pricing or billing pages read
tooling: The vendor runs the hosted service; the user adds an iOS, Android or web SDK, calls the REST or Management API, and uses the web dashboard. No software is installed to run the push service itself.
chaining: A hosted service with a REST API, web dashboard and SDKs for iOS, Android and the web; no machine is supplied by the user. Self-hosted push servers are a separate option and are considered after this hosted offer.

limits.value: 0 subscribers is free; EUR 1 per month for 1-1000 subscribers, EUR 2 for 1001-2000, EUR 3 for 2001-3000, plus EUR 1 per further 1000
a 14-day free trial with no credit card; after it, sending is blocked until payment is supplied and unpaid data is deleted after 90 days

limits_note: A maximum monthly budget can be set; when it is reached the service stops signing up new users while other activity continues. Push sending is unlimited and no per-message price is published.
binding_note: The subscriber count sets the price from the first subscriber, so the 0-subscriber free state ends as soon as one device opts in.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for an email address, a password and a confirmation password with a reCAPTCHA, and offers Brevo, Google, GitHub, Facebook and Shopify sign-in. The pricing page states that the 14-day trial needs no credit card. Payment details are taken only when the plan starts, through Stripe.

reliability_note: The vendor states a push delivery speed of 350k messages per second. Three failed payment collections suspend sending until invoices are paid; unpaid project and subscriber data is deleted after 90 days. European user data is stored in Europe.
confidence_note: The price, subscriber definition, trial, retention windows and payment terms are read on the first-party pricing page and billing documentation; the sign-up fields are read from the first-party sign-up form. No account was opened and no payment was made.
